Data observed at an analysis cutoff

Source: R/CutoffData.R
CutoffData.Rd

Restricts data generated by rOncoEndpoints to patients enrolled before an analysis cutoff (calendar time) and censors PFS and OS at the cutoff. Response is counted as observed when the patient responded and, if a time to response was generated, the response occurred before the cutoff and before dropout.

Usage

CutoffData(data, cutoff)

Arguments

data

A data frame returned by rOncoEndpoints.

cutoff

Calendar time of the cutoff: a scalar, or one value per simulated trial in data, in increasing order of sim (as returned by EventTime). NA means no cutoff.

Value

The rows of data with accrual_time < cutoff, with pfs_tte, pfs_event, os_tte, os_event, pfs_calendar_time and os_calendar_time recomputed, and the added columns response_obs and cutoff.

Examples

arm <- OncoArm(pfs.median = 6, orr = 0.3, resp.cor = 0.4, death.prop = 0.15,
               os.median = 15, resp.timing = "ttr", resp.tau = 1.5,
               ttr.median = 2.5)
dat <- rOncoEndpoints(nsim = 2, n = 100, arms = arm, a.time = c(0, 12),
                      seed = 1)
cut <- CutoffData(dat, cutoff = 9)
table(cut$sim, cut$response_obs)
#>    
#>      0  1
#>   1 60 13
#>   2 63 19
